No test was weakened to conceal a failure. Red r8 records the PM text-wins decision before Green 0356c23. J1/J2 retain exit checks, timeout checks, exact verdict assertions, cleanup, and the hostile inputs. Their changed expectations implement the recorded contract instead of accepting either verdict. N27 now exercises accumulated overflow, and Y10 retains unsafe-field rejection. F7 now uses a stronger fixture.

Last-block behavior remains covered by judge-run.test.ts:1441, which checks two flat blocks and exact final verdicts. The changed J1 no longer decides text-versus-result by arrival order. My independent two-text-event fixture still selects the last flat block. This review does not classify the approved precedence change as test weakening.

Decoder proof: I evaluated the actual TypeScript functions and embedded judge decoder in memory. Result-last, result-first, result-only, plain, two-text-block, and nested-result streams agree across all three decoders. The judge selects the text verdict for mixed streams, the result verdict for result-only streams, and the last flat block for two text events.

N26 proof: I ran the actual error_line_of from each runner under set -euo pipefail with a 307200-byte synthetic error in a memory file. Both emitted 499 content bytes plus a newline and exited 0. No manual fixture was written to disk.

G2 proof: Both guards now use find -print -quit without a pipe. The review G2 case creates 20000 symlinks and requires exit 2 with the named refusal. It passes in the full-file run. Root resolution now lies inside the extracted guard block, so the test does not depend on a missing JOB_REAL variable.

Missing-record and empty-output fixtures fail the new N26 assertions. No Measure orchestration script, framework contract test, or registry changed, so framework-wide checks remain outside this review.

Audit limits: I read no real private key, seeded diff, raw output, or shared credential store. I ran no live model, opencode CLI, or openchamber CLI. I did not repeat the full private-data leak gate. The four pre-existing untracked paths remain unchanged. Only the supplied result JSON and log were written by this audit.
